{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection1","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    private const string TestSource = @\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TempProject\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class MyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public MyEnum Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    public enum MyEnum\n    {\n        A = 0,\n        B = 1,\n    }\n}\n\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_IncludesExcludeFromCodeCoverage_OnNet80()\n    {\n        (GeneratedSourceResult generatedSource, INamedTypeSymbol formatterSymbol) = await RunGeneratorForEnumFormatterAsync();\n\n        string generatedText = generatedSource.SourceText.ToString();\n        Assert.Contains(\"#if !NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK\", generatedText, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n        Assert.Contains(\"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\", generatedText, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        bool hasAttribute = HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute(formatterSymbol);\n        Assert.True(hasAttribute);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_ExcludesExcludeFromCodeCoverage_OnNetStandard20()\n    {\n        (GeneratedSourceResult generatedSource, INamedTypeSymbol formatterSymbol) = await RunGeneratorForEnumFormatterAsync(\"NETSTANDARD2_0\");\n\n        string generatedText = generatedSource.SourceText.ToString();\n        Assert.Contains(\"#if !NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK\", generatedText, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        bool hasAttribute = HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute(formatterSymbol);\n        Assert.False(hasAttribute);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_ExcludesExcludeFromCodeCoverage_OnNetFramework()\n    {\n        (GeneratedSourceResult generatedSource, INamedTypeSymbol formatterSymbol) = await RunGeneratorForEnumFormatterAsync(\"NETFRAMEWORK\");\n\n        string generatedText = generatedSource.SourceText.ToString();\n        Assert.Contains(\"#if !NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK\", generatedText, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n\n        bool hasAttribute = HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute(formatterSymbol);\n        Assert.False(hasAttribute);\n    }\n\n    private static bool HasExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute(INamedTypeSymbol symbol)\n    {\n        return symbol.GetAttributes().Any(a =>\n            a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<(GeneratedSourceResult GeneratedSource, INamedTypeSymbol FormatterSymbol)> RunGeneratorForEnumFormatterAsync(params string[] preprocessorSymbols)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = frameworkRefs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest, preprocessorSymbols: preprocessorSymbols);\n        SyntaxTree syntaxTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(TestSource, parseOptions);\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { syntaxTree },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new[] { new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(generatorDiagnostics, d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(runResult.Diagnostics, d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(output.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult enumFormatterSource = runResult.Results\n            .SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources)\n            .Single(s =>\n            {\n                string text = s.SourceText.ToString();\n                return text.Contains(\"IMessagePackFormatter<\", StringComparison.Ordinal)\n                    && text.Contains(\"TempProject.MyEnum>\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n            });\n\n        SyntaxTree outputTree = output.SyntaxTrees.Single(t => t.FilePath == enumFormatterSource.SyntaxTree.FilePath);\n        SyntaxNode root = await outputTree.GetRootAsync();\n        ClassDeclarationSyntax classDeclaration = root.DescendantNodes()\n            .OfType<ClassDeclarationSyntax>()\n            .Single(c => c.Identifier.Text.Contains(\"MyEnum\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        SemanticModel semanticModel = output.GetSemanticModel(outputTree);\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterSymbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(classDeclaration);\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterSymbol);\n\n        return (enumFormatterSource, formatterSymbol!);\n    }\n}\n"}
